scoreObj.top_issue: The creator pitched a PPV in the very first reply to a brand-new fan without building rapport, as seen in 'aw thanks, alright heres a lil tease' immediately followed by the PPV message.
scoreObj.fix_recommendation: Revise the prompt to mandate at least 2-3 back-and-forth exchanges with flirty questions or personal engagement before any PPV pitch for new fans. Train the persona to deflect initial freebie demands by redirecting to casual conversation to build heat naturally.
